introTr: Bu hafta geçmiş zamanı öğrendin; şimdi neler oturmuş bir bakalım. Bu bir not sınavı değil, sadece nerede olduğunu görmen için. Bilmediğin soruda tahmin edebilirsin, acele etme.

items.q: Twenty years ago, my grandparents ___ farmers in Isparta.
items.whyTr: Çoğul özne (grandparents) ve geçmiş zaman: were.

items.q: I ___ very tired yesterday evening.
items.whyTr: I ile geçmişte 'was' kullanılır.

items.q: We ___ dinner at a restaurant last Saturday.
items.whyTr: Have fiilinin geçmişi düzensiz: had.

items.q: The school bus ___ in front of our building.
items.whyTr: Kısa, tek heceli fiillerde son harf ikilenir: stop - stopped.

items.q: Emre ___ for his math test last night.
items.whyTr: Ünsüz + y ile biten fiilde y düşer, -ied eklenir: studied.

items.q: Linda ___ me a nice gift for my birthday.
items.whyTr: Give fiilinin geçmişi düzensiz: gave.

items.q: We ___ a new car last month.
items.whyTr: Buy fiilinin geçmişi düzensiz: bought.

items.q: I ___ go to work yesterday because I was sick.
items.whyTr: Geçmiş zamanda olumsuz: didn't + fiilin yalın hali.

items.q: She didn't ___ the email to the manager.
items.whyTr: Didn't'ten sonra fiil yalın hali alır: send (sent değil).

items.q: ___ you watch the game last night?
items.whyTr: Geçmiş zaman sorusu 'Did' ile başlar.

items.q: What time did the meeting ___ yesterday?
items.whyTr: Did'den sonra fiil yalın hali alır: start.

items.q: Where ___ you born?
items.whyTr: 'Born' ile 'was/were born' kullanılır; you ile were.

items.q: I moved to the United States three years ___.
items.whyTr: Geçmişteki bir zamandan bu yana geçen süre için 'ago' kullanılır.

items.q: We visited my cousin ___ month.
items.whyTr: 'Last month' (geçen ay) bir geçmiş zaman ifadesidir.

items.q: First I cooked dinner. ___ I washed the dishes.
items.whyTr: Sıra bildiren bağlaç: first, then, after that.

items.q: Look! Mr. Brown ___ to the principal in the hallway.
items.whyTr: 'Look!' şu an olan bir olayı gösterir: is talking.

items.q: Emre ___ his homework after dinner every day.
items.whyTr: Her gün tekrarlanan iş + Emre (he): does.

items.q: Next week, I ___ visit my friend in Chicago.
items.whyTr: Plan için: am/is/are going to + fiil.

items.q: Don't worry. I ___ help you with the bags.
items.whyTr: Anlık karar ve yardım teklifi için 'will' kullanılır.

items.q: I ___ in this city since 2020.
items.whyTr: 'Since' ile hâlâ süren durum: present perfect.

items.q: What is the opposite of 'cheap'?
items.whyTr: Cheap (ucuz) kelimesinin zıttı expensive (pahalı).

items.q: 'The weather was awful on Sunday.' Awful means:
items.whyTr: Awful, çok kötü demektir.

items.q: Which word means the same as 'glad'?
items.whyTr: Glad ve happy aynı anlama gelir.

items.q: She ___ a mistake on the form.
items.whyTr: 'Make a mistake' sabit bir kalıptır.

items.q: What is the opposite of 'early'?
items.whyTr: Early (erken) kelimesinin zıttı late (geç).

items.q: 'The store is crowded on Saturdays.' Crowded means:
items.whyTr: Crowded, insanlarla dolu demektir.

items.q: Can you ___ me a favor?
items.whyTr: 'Do someone a favor' kalıbı: bir iyilik yapmak.

items.q: Which word means the same as 'quick'?
items.whyTr: Quick ve fast aynı anlama gelir.

items.q: 'Hafsa's first apartment was tiny.' Tiny means:
items.whyTr: Tiny, çok küçük demektir.

items.q: What is the opposite of 'remember'?
items.whyTr: Remember (hatırlamak) kelimesinin zıttı forget (unutmak).

items.q: 'The cashier gave me the wrong change.' Change means:
items.whyTr: Change, alışverişte para üstü demektir.

items.q: Which word means the same as 'repair'?
items.whyTr: Repair ve fix aynı anlama gelir: tamir etmek.

passages.title: A busy Saturday
passages.text:
Last Saturday, Hafsa had a very busy day. In the morning, she cleaned the apartment and washed the clothes. Then she went to the market with Linda. They bought apples, cheese, and bread.

At noon, Emre came home from his friend's house. He was hungry, so Hafsa made soup. After lunch, they watched a movie. In the evening, Hafsa was tired, but she was happy. She didn't cook dinner. They ate sandwiches.

questions.q: What did Hafsa do in the morning?
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'In the morning, she cleaned the apartment.'
Metinde: 'He was hungry, so Hafsa made soup.'

questions.q: What did they eat for dinner?
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'She didn't cook dinner. They ate sandwiches.'

passages.title: A problem at the bank
passages.text:
On Sunday, Hafsa's bank card didn't work at the grocery store. She was embarrassed, and she paid with cash. On Monday morning, she went to the bank near her apartment.

A young man named Kevin helped her. 'I'm sorry about the problem,' he said. 'The bank changed its system last week.' He asked for her ID and gave her a new card in ten minutes. He also showed her how to use the bank app on her phone.

Hafsa left the bank with a smile. She said, 'Thank you. You helped me a lot.'

questions.q: Why did Hafsa go to the bank?
questions.whyTr: Metinde kartı markette çalışmadı ve bankaya gitti.
Metinde: 'gave her a new card in ten minutes'.
Metinde: 'a new card in ten minutes'.

questions.q: How did Hafsa feel when she left the bank?

passages.title: Moving to America
passages.text:
Hafsa moved to the United States four years ago. At first, everything was difficult. The weather was cold, the food was different, and she couldn't understand people on the phone. Her neighbor Linda helped her a lot. She took Hafsa to the grocery store and showed her the bus map.

Now Hafsa feels more comfortable. She has a few good friends, and she studies English every day. Next year, she is going to take a course for substitute teachers.

questions.q: When did Hafsa move to the United States?
Who helped Hafsa after she arrived?
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'Her neighbor Linda helped her a lot.'

questions.q: What is Hafsa going to do next year?
options: Take a course for substitute teachers
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'she is going to take a course for substitute teachers'.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Hi, Hafsa! How was your weekend?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: It was nice, thanks. On Saturday we visited a farm with Emre.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Oh, did you like it?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes! Emre fed the animals. But it rained in the afternoon, so we went home early.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: What did you do on Sunday?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I stayed home and cooked. I made a big pot of lentil soup. Do you want some?

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: I'd love some. Thank you!

questions.q: Where did Hafsa go on Saturday?
questions.whyTr: Hafsa: 'we visited a farm with Emre'.

questions.q: Why did they go home early?
questions.whyTr: Hafsa: 'it rained in the afternoon, so we went home early'.

questions.q: What did Hafsa do on Sunday?
questions.whyTr: Hafsa evde kaldı ve mercimek çorbası yaptı.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Dr. Evans' office. How can I help you?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment. My tooth hurts.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: I'm sorry to hear that. When did the pain start?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Two days ago. I couldn't sleep last night.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: We have an opening tomorrow at 10:30 or on Thursday at 2:00.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Tomorrow is better for me.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Okay. Please come fifteen minutes early to fill out a form.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thank you. See you tomorrow.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Hafsa, are you free next Friday? We need help at the book fair.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I think so. What time does it start?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: It starts at 9:00 and finishes at 1:00.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Okay. What should I bring?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Just a bottle of water. We don't have a lot of drinks.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: No problem. I will be there at 8:45.

questions.q: What does Mr. Brown need help with?
questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'We need help at the book fair.'
Mr. Brown: 'Just a bottle of water.'

writing.promptTr: Arkadaşına geçen hafta sonunu anlatan kısa bir paragraf yaz. Nereye gittin, ne yaptın, nasıl hissettin? Geçmiş zaman kullanmayı unutma.
writing.promptEn: Write a short paragraph about your last weekend. Where did you go? What did you do? How did you feel?
checklistTr: Fiilleri geçmiş zamanda yazdım mı (went, visited, cooked)?
Düzensiz fiilleri doğru kullandım mı (went, had, bought)?
Olumsuz cümlede didn't + yalın fiil kullandım mı?
last Saturday / yesterday gibi zaman ifadeleri ekledim mi?
First, then, after that ile sıra verdim mi?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve nokta ile bitiyor mu?
writing.model: Last weekend was very nice. On Saturday, I went to the farmers market with my neighbor Linda. We bought vegetables and bread. Then we had tea at a small coffee shop. On Sunday, I cooked a big dinner for my son Emre. We watched a movie after dinner. I didn't clean the house, but I felt happy and relaxed.
